PDF67–70: RK and uniform-field trajectories are alternative reconstructions. In simulation, RK improves the absolute A/Z centroid, yet the resolutions are comparable. The author chooses the faster uniform-field method for this PID analysis.

PDF79 gives nominal 240 and central 239 MeV/u in the carbon target. PDF99 Table 4.4 gives 15.9(2.1) mb at the stated 900 mg/cm² target. This is an inclusive 15B residue cross section, not a resolved gamma-final-state cross section.

PDF102–103 Table 4.6 distinguishes the external 400 MeV/u result 20.5(1.1) mb from the 16.4(1.1) mb value corrected by dividing the central value by 1.25. At 240 MeV/u the two MOMDIS treatments give R_s=0.29(4) and 0.28(4).
works.gap: Acceptance and particle tails are model/calibration dependent. Residual-nucleus counting does not separate the bound 15B final states. R_s comparisons depend on external energy points, target and model conventions, including the explicit 400 MeV/u empirical correction.
works.lineage: Original ETF RIBLL2 measurement at 240 MeV/u; the 75 and 400 MeV/u results are from other experiments and are treated conditionally in the model comparison.
